Description: 
 This position will function as a Business Analyst and InfoPath Forms Developer. The individual in this position must meet with Agency form owners to solidify automated forms requirements, develop forms, work through testing of automated forms, and promote InfoPath form to the production environment. 
 

 Role: BA - InfoPath Forms Developer 
 Location: Lansing,MI 
 Duration : 6+ months. 
 
 
 Skills Required:   
 Must have working knowledge of SharePoint 2010, experience using InfoPath, and experience functioning as a Business Analyst. 
   
 Skills Preferred : 
 SharePoint 2013 Ability to work with diverse group of clients. 
   
 Education Required:  Possession of a Bachelor's degree with 21 semester (32 term) credits in computer science, data processing, computer information, data communication, networking, system analysis, computer programming, mathematics, or IT project management. 
 
 
 Send me your resume to sandeep AT tekwissen DOT com 

 
 Additional Information:   Technical environment for the work: SharePoint 2010 (migrating to 2013) InfoPath 2010 Windows 7
